checks.label: Accruals ratio
checks.line: Net income minus operating cash flow equals 14.1% of average assets.
checks.rule: Net income minus operating cash flow, divided by average total assets. Within plus or minus 5%: Pass. 5% to 10%: Watch. Above 10%: Fail.

checks.label: Stock based compensation
checks.line: Stock based pay equals 2.3% of revenue.
checks.rule: Stock based compensation as a share of revenue. Below 3%: Pass. 3% to 8%: Watch. Above 8%: Fail.

checks.label: Receivables versus revenue
checks.line: Receivables or revenue growth not computable.
checks.rule: Receivables growth minus revenue growth, latest year. Up to 5 points: Pass. 5 to 15 points: Watch. Above 15 points: Fail.

checks.label: One time items
checks.line: One time charges equal 4.4% of operating income.
checks.rule: Restructuring, impairment and other one time charges as a share of operating income. Below 5%: Pass. 5% to 15%: Watch. Above 15%: Fail. None reported: Pass.
